query: For my 56‑year‑old patient: among female patients 51–61 with heart failure, ICU vs no ICU, LOS <8 vs ≥8 and comorbidity burden (low/med/high), report in‑hospital mortality rates, absolute/relative differences, MV/vaso/RRT prevalence.
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, CASE WHEN p.age BETWEEN 51 AND 61 THEN '51-61' WHEN p.age BETWEEN 41 AND 50 THEN '41-50' WHEN p.age BETWEEN 31 AND 40 THEN '31-40' WHEN p.age BETWEEN 21 AND 30 THEN '21-30' WHEN p.age BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN '11-20' WHEN p.age BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN '1-10' END AS age_group, h.admission_type_code, i.icustay_id, i.los, d.diagnosis_code, d.diagnosis_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.dod IS NOT NULL THEN a.subject_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.subject_id), 0) AS mortality_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.dod IS NOT NULL THEN a.subject_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.icustay_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.subject_id END) AS deaths_in_icu, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.dod IS NOT NULL THEN a.subject_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.icustay_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.subject_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.los < 8 THEN a.subject_id END) AS deaths_in_los_lt_8, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.dod IS NOT NULL THEN a.subject_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.icustay_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.subject_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.los < 8 THEN a.subject_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.diagnosis_code = '440.0' THEN a.subject_id END) AS deaths_without_heart_failure, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.dod IS NOT NULL THEN a.subject_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.icustay_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.subject_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.los < 8 THEN a.subject_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.diagnosis_code = '440.0' THEN a.subject_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.diagnosis_code = '440.0' THEN a.subject_id END) AS deaths_without_heart_failure_or_icu, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.dod IS NOT NULL THEN a.subject_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.icustay_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.subject_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.los < 8 THEN a.subject_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.diagnosis_code = '440.0' THEN a.subject_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.diagnosis_code = '440.0' THEN a.subject_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.diagnosis_code = '440.0' THEN a.subject_id END) AS deaths_without_heart_failure_or_icu_or_los_lt_8, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.dod IS NOT NULL THEN a.subject_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.icustay_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.subject_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.los < 8 THEN a.subject_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.diagnosis_code = '440.0' THEN a.subject_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.diagnosis_code = '440.0' THEN a.subject_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.diagnosis_code = '440.0' THEN a.subject_id END) -;
